strengths: Most specific supported identity: VIP, CALB2, NR2F2, ADARB2, PPP1R1C, CXCL14, SLC22A3, RGS8, THSD7B, KMO, CHRNA7 directly mark VIP cortical GABAergic interneurons.
Negative evidence correctly excludes excitatory neurons (SLC17A7/CAMK2A/RORB) and SST/PVALB/LAMP5 interneuron populations.
weaknesses: Some rank-2 subtype speculation (CCK-like, RELN layer 1-2) goes beyond the observed markers (e.g., CCK itself is absent).

strengths: Correct broad GABAergic lineage supported by VIP/CALB2/NR2F2/ADARB2 and GABA-ergic synapse enrichment.
weaknesses: Under-specific; the same evidence supports the more specific VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron (CL:4023016), which was already its rank-2 candidate.

strengths: Correctly identifies inhibitory neuron identity from VIP, CALB2, NR2F2, RELN and absence of excitatory/glial markers.
weaknesses: Enrichment terms (e.g., GABA-ergic synapse, GABA synthesis) are shared by all GABAergic neurons and do not provide VIP-branch specificity.

supporting: VIP, CALB2, NR2F2, ADARB2, PPP1R1C, CXCL14, SLC22A3, RGS8, THSD7B, KMO, CHRNA7 directly support VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron identity (CL:4023016).
GABA-ergic synapse and GABA synthesis enrichment plus absence of SLC17A7/SLC17A6 excitatory markers support GABAergic lineage.
PMID 31452791 provides literature support for the VIP cortical interneuron identity.
conflicting: No canonical excitatory (SLC17A7/SLC17A6) or SST/PVALB/LAMP5 interneuron markers were observed among top DEGs, so no alternative branch has positive support.
enrichment_or_literature: GABA-ergic synapse; GABA synthesis; GABA synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation; Neuronal System
